profile.headline: Hi there! I'm Mahamudul Hasan
profile.summary: I am studying Computer Science and Engineering at United International University, with interests in software engineering, web-based systems, and game development. I enjoy building practical projects with clear structure, useful interfaces, and maintainable code.

about.label: About Me
about.title: I Build Practical Digital Experiences
about.primary: I am Mahamudul Hasan, a CSE student at United International University. My academic path started with a science background and now focuses on software engineering fundamentals, programming, databases, and project-based development.
about.secondary: My public projects include a smart city complaint management system, a digital library platform, and this personal portfolio. I am especially interested in growing as a software engineer and exploring game development through stronger programming and system design skills.
about.quote: I believe good software starts with clear thinking, consistent practice, and useful real-world projects.
